Upgrade my AI Anime Video Generator.

Add episode duration options:

- 5 minutes
- 10 minutes
- 20 minutes
- 30 minutes

The user can paste a complete Hindi story. AI should automatically divide it into scenes and generate a complete anime episode with:

- Consistent anime characters
- Natural Hindi male voices
- Character-specific dialogues
- Animated scenes
- Background music and sound effects
- Hindi subtitles
- Automatic scene joining

Generate the video in smaller clips and combine them into one complete MP4 episode.

Show generation progress and save unfinished projects.

The selected duration must be respected as closely as the available generation service allows. Never show fake progress or claim a video is complete when it is not.

Keep the app free to access and clearly disclose any generation limits or API costs. creat app

issues.detail:
Achievable now: We can build an AI anime video generator that processes Hindi stories into scenes with character dialogues, shows real progress, and prepares for actual video generation using external services.
Honest scope note: Full video generation requires external AI media APIs (text-to-speech, image/video generation) which may have usage limits or costs that users must configure.
Step 1 — Story Input & Scene Division Engine [infra ceiling]
  goal: Paste any Hindi story, select episode duration (5/10/20/30 mins), and get an automatic breakdown of scenes with character assignments and dialogues - all working with real processing, no simulation
  build: Create a React frontend (single file if possible) with a text input for pasting Hindi stories and radio buttons for selecting episode duration (5/10/20/30 minutes). When the user clicks 'Process Story', run actual logic to divide the story into appropriate scene lengths based on word count and selected duration. Display clear scene-by-scene breakdown showing character names, dialogues in Hindi, and scene descriptions. Store this project data in localStorage so users can revisit unfinished projects. Never show fake progress - only show actual computed results. The selected duration must be respected as closely as the available generation service allows.
Step 2 — Hindi Voice Generation Integration [infra ceiling]
  goal: Each character gets consistent natural male Hindi voice audio clips for their dialogues - generated via real text-to-speech API, not simulated
  build: Build real integration with a Hindi text-to-speech API (user provides their own API key). For each character dialogue identified in the previous step, make actual TTS calls to generate separate audio files. Show download links for each clip and overall progress percentage. Allow resuming generation of missing clips. Never show fake progress or simulate completed audio. The selected duration must be respected as closely as the available generation service allows. Continue using localStorage for saving project state.
Step 3 — Visual Scene Preview System [infra ceiling]
  goal: See visual previews of each animated scene with character images, backgrounds, and sample subtitles before full video generation
  build: Integrate with an image generation API (user provides API key) to create visual previews for each scene. Display character assets, background placeholders, and Hindi subtitles overlay. Handle both text prompts for scene imagery and store generated image URLs. Show clear indication which scenes have visual previews and which are pending. Never simulate completed images. The selected duration must be respected as closely as the available generation service allows. Persist all scene data including visual elements in localStorage.
Step 4 — Video Clip Generation Engine [infra ceiling]
  goal: Convert each scene into individual video clips combining voice, visuals, subtitles, music and sound effects using real media generation services
  build: Use video generation APIs (users provide keys) to create individual scene videos combining: character voices from step 2, scene images from step 3, Hindi subtitles, basic background music/sound effect placeholders. Track actual upload/generation progress for each clip. Show detailed per-scene status and estimated completion times. Allow pausing/resuming generation. Never show simulated progress. The selected duration must be respected as closely as the available generation service allows. Save all intermediate video URLs in localStorage.
Step 5 — Episode Assembly & Export [infra ceiling]
  goal: Combine all generated video clips into one seamless MP4 episode respecting chosen duration plus add final subtitles and audio mix
  build: Implement video concatenation either through browser capabilities (WebCodecs) or backend API (user provides endpoint). Combine all generated scene clips sequentially into single MP4 maintaining proper timing. Overlay final Hindi subtitles and mix background music/effects with dialogue audio properly. Provide final download link for complete episode. Clearly indicate actual vs estimated duration achieved. Never fake successful export. The selected duration must be respected as closely as the available generation service allows. Preserve ability to resume failed assemblies.
Step 6 — Progress Dashboard & Cost Controls [infra ceiling]
  goal: Full overview of all ongoing/past projects with generation history, usage tracking, and transparent cost disclosure
  build: Create dashboard showing all saved projects with status indicators (processing/completed/failed), actual durations achieved, storage usage, and per-API cost estimates based on user-configured pricing. Include clear explanations of potential costs for each external service used. Add manual cleanup options for old projects. Ensure every progress indicator reflects true system states, never simulations. The selected duration must be respected as closely as the available generation service allows while being transparent about limitations.
